derivation:
classical
  simpa only [← Multiset.map_erase_of_mem _ _ h] using!
    Multiset.noncommProd_erase_mul (s.1.map f) (Multiset.mem_map_of_mem f h) _
explanation: The Finset statement is exactly the Multiset statement `Multiset.noncommProd_erase_mul` (Mathlib/Data/Finset/NoncommProd.lean, line 219: `(s.erase a).noncommProd comm' * a = s.noncommProd comm`) instantiated at the multiset `s.1.map f`, where `Finset.noncommProd s f comm` is by definition `(s.1.map f).noncommProd comm` and `(s.erase a).noncommProd f comm'` is `((s.1.map f).erase (f a)).noncommProd comm'`, identified via `Multiset.map_erase_of_mem`. The library's proof is precisely this instantiation, so the Finset lemma is a special case of the Multiset one (which is an independent declaration, not the theorem under judgement).
